import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
# Puerto Rico approximate bounds
puerto_rico = ee.Geometry.Polygon([
    [[-67.3, 17.9], [-67.3, 18.5], [-65.2, 18.5], [-65.2, 17.9], [-67.3, 17.9]]
])

date1_start = '2016-09-21'
date1_end = '2016-09-22'
date2_start = '2016-09-22'
date2_end = '2016-09-23'

# 2. Data Acquisition
col1 = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMCFG') \
    .filterDate(date1_start, date1_end) \
    .filterBounds(puerto_rico)

col2 = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMCFG') \
    .filterDate(date2_start, date2_end) \
    .filterBounds(puerto_rico)

size1 = col1.size().getInfo()
size2 = col2.size().getInfo()

# Monthly data won't work for daily comparison, try daily
if size1 == 0 or size2 == 0:
    # Use annual composite as fallback with month filter
    col1 = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/ANNUAL_V2') \
        .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(2016, 2016, 'year')) \
        .filterBounds(puerto_rico)
    
    size1 = col1.size().getInfo()
    
    if size1 == 0:
        print("No VIIRS nighttime data available for September 2016.")
        print("<answer>C1</answer>")
        exit()
    
    # Annual data doesn't allow day-by-day comparison
    print("Only annual VIIRS data available, cannot compare specific dates.")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
    exit()

# 3. Get images
img1 = col1.first()
img2 = col2.first()

# 4. Calculate mean nighttime light intensity
stats1 = img1.select('avg_rad').reduceRegion(
    reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
    geometry=puerto_rico,
    scale=1000,
    maxPixels=1e9
)

stats2 = img2.select('avg_rad').reduceRegion(
    reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
    geometry=puerto_rico,
    scale=1000,
    maxPixels=1e9
)

val1 = stats1.get('avg_rad').getInfo()
val2 = stats2.get('avg_rad').getInfo()

# Check pixel counts
count1 = img1.select('avg_rad').reduceRegion(
    reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
    geometry=puerto_rico,
    scale=1000,
    maxPixels=1e9
).get('avg_rad').getInfo()

count2 = img2.select('avg_rad').reduceRegion(
    reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
    geometry=puerto_rico,
    scale=1000,
    maxPixels=1e9
).get('avg_rad').getInfo()

# 5. Validation & Final Answer
print(f"Sept 21: {size1} images, Mean: {val1}, Pixels: {int(count1)}")
print(f"Sept 22: {size2} images, Mean: {val2}, Pixels: {int(count2)}")

if count1 == 0 or count2 == 0:
    print("No valid pixels in one or both dates.")
    print("<answer>C2</answer>")
elif val1 is None or val2 is None or val1 < 0 or val2 < 0:
    print("Invalid nighttime light values.")
    print("<answer>C3</answer>")
elif val2 < val1:
    print(f"Decline detected: {val1:.4f} -> {val2:.4f}")
    print("<answer>A</answer>")
else:
    print(f"No decline: {val1:.4f} -> {val2:.4f}")
    print("<answer>B</answer>")
